tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background, drawers, popovers and the quick-add panel (color_palette.background). The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: surface-sand
tokens.usage: Warm tinted band: announcement bar, homepage hero, the Comfortsets product list and the sold-out badge. Alternate it with surface and surface-raised to separate homepage sections.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: White: inputs, variant buttons, the USP band and the story section. Use it where a section needs to feel lighter than the cream page.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text, headings and secondary-button outline (color_palette.foreground). 13.9:1 on surface, 11.7:1 on surface-sand.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Added by this system (not in the theme): secondary text such as captions, helper text and per-unit prices. 5.9:1 on surface, 5.0:1 on surface-sand.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on inputs, variant buttons, drawers and popovers. Decorative only (1.3:1 on surface); never the only boundary of a control a person must find.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary buttons, the sale badge and eyebrow text. 5.2:1 on surface, 5.5:1 on white. On surface-sand it is 4.4:1, just under AA for small text; the hero eyebrow uses it there at 16px uppercase, so keep eyebrows at 16px+ or move them to surface.

tokens.name: on-terracotta
tokens.usage: Text and icons on terracotta (primary button, sale badge). 5.5:1.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Dark band for the risk-free guarantee section and the selected variant button.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse. 13.9:1.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: One per page: the hero promise. display-tight leading.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Centered section statements (story, guarantee) and page titles.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Product-list headers and sub-sections on content pages.

styles.name: h4
styles.sample: Waarom je dit fijn gaat vinden
styles.usage: Headings inside product descriptions and FAQ questions.

styles.name: h6
styles.usage: Tags inside controls, e.g. the quantity-break flag. Price uses this preset in product cards at 16px.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase line above the hero h1, in terracotta. Keep at 16px (see terracotta note).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Doe het om, kies je stand en ontspan 15 minuten.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a product card's image, title and price.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top padding on a product title under its image; tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Announcement bar vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap in a product-list header (title ↔ 'Alles bekijken' link).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Column gap in product grids; page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Stack gap inside hero-style sections (eyebrow, title, text, buttons).

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Gap between a product-list header and its grid; USP band vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Row gap in product grids.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of product-list sections.

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the inverse guarantee band.

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the story section.

tokens.name: space-120
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the homepage hero. The largest step; one per page.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Text inputs, the discount-code field.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Product images, product cards and menu images.

tokens.name: radius-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers and variant (quantity) buttons.

tokens.name: radius-swatch
tokens.usage: Round colour swatches (34×34).

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons: always pill-shaped.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges (sale, sold out).

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Inputs, secondary buttons, variant buttons, drawers and popovers. Primary buttons have no border.

tokens.name: logo-height
tokens.usage: Header logo height on desktop.

tokens.name: logo-height-mobile
tokens.usage: Header logo height on mobile.

tokens.name: swatch-size
tokens.usage: Width and height of a variant swatch.
